technique_name: Create an example of an informative speech about a specific topic.
description: Good morning! Today, I am here to speak about the topic of invasive species and their effects on ecosystems. An invasive species is a species of plants, animals, fungi, or other organisms that are not native to a specific location, and which can cause harm to the environment and native species. Invasive species have negative effects on ecosystems, by out-competing native species, disrupting food webs, and reducing biodiversity.
